config.name: g1_interruption_demo
config._note: Test D on fresh nominal rooms 4100-4102 (never used in development). The request arrives 2 s of robot time into the inspection's second action, i.e. while it walks. Pass requires: the interrupted walk stopped safely (< 0.15 m/s pelvis speed when it yielded), the urgent goto succeeded with true error <= 0.3 m, the inspection resumed and succeeded under Milestone B scoring, no false claim, no fall.
